modern.label: Modern
modern.summary: Warm contemporary: clean-lined, low-profile furniture in warm neutrals with natural wood and a few black metal accents. Calm, uncluttered, current.
modern.lighting_decor: Slim matte black or brass floor and table lamps with linen shades, lamps off or softly glowing to match the room's existing light.

minimalist.lighting_decor: One simple paper or linen floor lamp; no decorative clutter.
